archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) adapted for Engineering Compliance

colors.rules: No generic full-screen gradients. 95% monochrome UI. Color is function only. Use accent colors strictly for status/validation indicators.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look) - Use 1px solid borders (border-collapse style) for data-heavy sections, dashboards, and tables.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to None. Rely on crisp 1px borders instead of soft shadows to establish hierarchy. Use hard bottom borders for headers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Flat Solid surfaces. NO glassmorphism. Technical/engineering apps require maximum clarity without visual refraction.

layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Use F-pattern for data scanning.
layouts.spacing: Generous inner padding (p-6) for module cards to prevent text collision. Use p-8 to p-12 between major vertical sections.
layouts.alignment: Left-align all paragraphs, labels, dense content, and tabular data. Optical alignment for icons.
layouts.general: Modular UI with progressive disclosure. Show summary metrics first, reveal deep technical specs on click/expand.

components.wizard_stepper: Clean vertical or horizontal progress list with stark contrast for the active step. Muted styles for upcoming steps.
components.module_cards: Flat rectangular cards representing CTE, RSCIEI, REBT, etc., with 1px border, high-contrast typography, and hover lift (-translate-y-1).
components.data_tables: Dense Shadcn tables. Clear status pill badges (Cumple/No Cumple) in dedicated columns. Left-aligned text.
components.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Strict automatic validations. Data-dense but grouped logically.
components.report_panel: Split view: Rules engine results panel on the left/top + PDF preview or summary on the right/bottom.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text and background color (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Focus states must have higher contrast.
motion.page_transitions: Instant or fast fade (0.15s). Efficiency over delight in professional engineering tools.

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Min 4.5:1 for small text. No grey-on-grey text.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit', data-testid='create-estudio').
accessibility.forms: Clear error states with descriptive text below inputs, not just red borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be Spanish (Spanish/Catalan locale rules).
Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the Swiss Brutalist/Technical aesthetic (sharp edges, max 4px radius).
Do NOT use raw HTML components for dropdowns, date pickers, or selects. Use Shadcn components for accessibility.
Create a toggle for Dark/Light mode. Default to Light for daytime engineering environments.
Navigation bar must be visible on desktop. Ensure a SOLID background for the header to avoid transparent overlaps.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor icons for dense technical iconography.
Do NOT center align the app container. Use standard block/flex layouts.
Ensure the 'RSCIEI' module is treated as the fully operative MVP focal point.
Files should be .js/.jsx as per project structure, do not assume .tsx.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the 'AI slop' aesthetic by making it look like a high-end precise technical tool (Linear/Notion vibes).
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use F-pattern data-dense grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
Use Flat Solid backgrounds instead of glassmorphism for this technical context.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in css (no text-align: center on root).
Always use crisp, technical button styles (sharp corners or subtle 4px radius) with explicit interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robot, brain, lightbulb) for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Use sonner for toasts, expected in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
